summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate). Changes: new Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update (empty-request path builds the prologue via translatePrologue with base and initNs); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py covers the required cases. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Unverified: the new tests, the existing prepareQuery and DAWG update tests. The initial-bindings test (INSERT with ?s and empty WHERE) is the most likely to fail if its assumption about binding propagation is wrong.
